fullPassage:
Artificial Intelligence and the Arts

On March 13, 2016, an incident occurred that thrilled the contemporary art scene. An unknown painting that seemed to be a work of Rembrandt, the great 17th-century Dutch painter, had been discovered! Rembrandt experts from all over the world gathered to view this portrait of a middle-aged man. They immediately recognized the artist's vivid style, but thoroughly examined the painting to make sure. Several hours later, they confirmed, "This is a genuine Rembrandt." How wonderful to greet a new work of this extraordinary artist more than 300 years after his death!

Suddenly, a group of people appeared in front of them. Their representative announced, "This is not a genuine work of Rembrandt." The experts protested, "With these features of brush and paint, this painting cannot be any other artist's work!" The representative calmly explained, "This painting was created by an artificial intelligence system through 3D printing. We are the engineers who developed that AI system."

The experts asked them to offer some evidence. They immediately presented a video showing the AI's production process. Their AI program learned to imitate Rembrandt's typical characteristics by examining data from his 346 works. It was then given the order "Make a portrait of a Caucasian male, 30 to 40 years old, with facial hair, in dark clothing with a collar, wearing a hat, and facing to the right" and produced what seemed to be a genuine Rembrandt. The experts were stunned.

This was just one of the events that provoked the question: "Can AI art be real art?" This question is unresolved, but more and more art critics see AI-generated artworks as a new field of art, just as photography eventually came to be seen as art rather than technology more than a century ago.

In 2018, a portrait created by AI was sold for nearly half a million dollars. The painting, Portrait of Edmond de Belamy, was produced by an art group, using an algorithm and a data bank of 15,000 portraits. This sale helped AI artworks become more accepted in the traditional art world. In 2022, an AI-generated picture, Théâtre D'opéra Spatial, won first prize in the Colorado State Fair's art contest. Since then, more and more AI-generated artworks have been exhibited in art galleries.

There are different views of AI art. To many people, it is at best an imitation of human art, not a true art form with insight into life and society. Some oppose AI-generated art because it can steal the data of human art without respecting copyright. In contrast, some artists welcome AI as a tool to create new art forms. There are also those who insist that AI is more than a tool. They argue that the results of AI creation are largely beyond human control and AI should therefore be seen as existing in its own right.

Let us look at the mechanism of AI creativity, which is programmed to work in a similar way to human creativity. Think of the AI technology of neural networks. It makes a machine "think," distinguish, and create in a similar way to a human brain. The machine doesn't simply follow human orders but learns by itself, which is done through a branch of machine learning called deep learning. This learning process enables a machine to discover distinct patterns from numerous data. Moreover, AI can even learn established art styles only to avoid them. It can then create a new, unique style.

This pattern of AI creation is much like the path taken by major artists such as Picasso and Van Gogh. These artists trained themselves by learning and mimicking other artists' styles until they found and created their own.

Of course, this does not mean that an AI system becomes an artist in the same way that a human does. Human artistic creativity, which raises ethical, social, or emotional questions through great art, is not yet thoroughly understood and cannot simply be compared with any AI system. Even so, we have better and better AI techniques which are able to imitate human creative activities. AI has already generated art that some viewers consider more impressive or moving than human art.

Now, we see AI platforms and apps that create pictures, music albums, and novels if we simply provide them with an idea. Although our question, "Can AI art be real art?", is still valid, AI can be a powerful source of inspiration and ideas for artists. AI-generated art will continue to challenge our views on creativity in the arts and the human relationship with machine intelligence.

questions.passage: On March 13, 2016, an incident occurred that thrilled the (A)[contemporary / temporary] art scene. An unknown painting that seemed to be a work of Rembrandt, the great 17th-century Dutch painter, had been discovered! Rembrandt experts from all over the world gathered to view this portrait of a middle-aged man. They immediately recognized the artist's (B)[vivid / vague] style, but thoroughly examined the painting to make sure. Several hours later, they confirmed, "This is a (C)[genuine / general] Rembrandt." How wonderful to greet a new work of this extraordinary artist more than 300 years after his death!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 현대 미술계, (B) 생생한 화풍, (C) 진품 렘브란트
det.analysis:
✅ ① contemporary — vivid — genuine ←정답
(A) contemporary(현대의): 2016년의 미술계 수식. temporary(일시적인)는 미술계 수식에 부적절.
(B) vivid(생생한): 렘브란트의 뚜렷한 화풍. vague(모호한)는 반대 의미.
(C) genuine(진짜의): 진품 렘브란트. general(일반적인)은 의미 불일치.

❌ ② temporary — vivid — general
❌ ③ contemporary — vague — general
❌ ④ temporary — vague — genuine
det.tip: contemporary(동시대의) vs temporary(일시적인). genuine(진짜의) vs general(일반적인) — 형태 유사, 의미 다름.

questions.passage: The experts asked them to offer some evidence. They immediately presented a video showing the AI's production process. Their AI program learned to (A)[imitate / eliminate] Rembrandt's typical characteristics by examining data from his 346 works. It was then given the order "Make a portrait of a Caucasian male, 30 to 40 years old, with facial hair, in dark clothing with a collar, wearing a hat, and facing to the right" and produced what seemed to be a genuine Rembrandt. The experts were (B)[stunned / relieved]. This was just one of the events that (C)[provoked / prevented] the question: "Can AI art be real art?" This question is unresolved, but more and more art critics see AI-generated artworks as a new field of art.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 모방하다, (B) 경악하다, (C) 촉발하다
det.analysis:
✅ ② imitate — stunned — provoked ←정답
(A) imitate(모방하다): AI가 렘브란트의 특징을 '모방'. eliminate(제거하다)는 반대.
(B) stunned(경악한): 진품인 줄 알았던 것이 AI 작품이라 경악. relieved(안도한)는 문맥 불일치.
(C) provoked(촉발한): 'AI 예술이 진짜 예술인가?' 질문을 '촉발'. prevented(방지한)는 반대.

❌ ① eliminate — stunned — provoked
❌ ③ imitate — relieved — prevented
❌ ④ imitate — stunned — prevented
det.tip: imitate(모방하다) ↔ eliminate(제거하다). provoke(촉발하다) ↔ prevent(방지하다).

questions.passage: Let us look at the mechanism of AI creativity, which is programmed to work in a similar way to human creativity. Think of the AI technology of neural networks. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 뚜렷한 패턴, (B) 확립된 양식, (C) 독특한 스타일
det.analysis:
✅ ③ distinct — established — unique ←정답
(A) distinct(뚜렷한): 데이터에서 '뚜렷한' 패턴 발견. extinct(멸종한)는 패턴 수식에 부적절.
(B) established(확립된): '확립된' 예술 양식을 배움. abandoned(버려진)는 배울 이유 없음.
(C) unique(독특한): '독특한' 스타일 창조. uniform(획일적인)은 '새로운'과 모순.

❌ ① extinct — established — unique
❌ ② distinct — abandoned — unique
❌ ④ distinct — established — uniform
det.tip: distinct(뚜렷한) vs extinct(멸종한) — 발음 유사. established(확립된) ↔ abandoned(버려진).

→ welcome(환영하다)의 반의어.

❌ ① portrait (초상화): 규칙과 무관.
❌ ② copyright (저작권): 법적 권리.
❌ ③ mechanism (메커니즘): 작동 방식이지 규칙 집합이 아님.
✅ ④ algorithm (알고리즘) ←정답
→ 컴퓨터가 따르는 규칙/단계 집합.
det.tip: algorithm — AI/컴퓨터 분야 핵심 어휘. 본문에서 15,000장의 초상화 데이터와 함께 사용됨.

questions.passage: Even so, we have better and better AI techniques which are able to imitate human creative activities. AI has already generated art that some viewers consider more __________ (impress) or moving than human art.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: AI가 만든 예술이 더 인상적이라고 생각하는 관객이 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ impressive: more + 형용사(비교급). impress(동사) → impressive(형용사) 변환 필요.
det.tip: impress(동사: 감동시키다) → impressive(형용사: 인상적인) → impression(명사: 인상). more impressive = 비교급.

questions.passage: Of course, this does not mean that an AI system becomes an artist in the same way that a human does. Human artistic __________ (creative), which raises ethical, social, or emotional questions through great art, is not yet thoroughly understood.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 인간의 예술적 창의성은 아직 충분히 이해되지 않았다.
det.analysis: ✅ creativity: artistic __________ → 형용사 뒤에 명사 필요. creative(형용사) → creativity(명사).
det.tip: create(동사) → creative(형용사) → creativity(명사: 창의성). 주어 자리이므로 명사.

questions.passage: Suddenly, a group of people appeared in front of them. Their representative announced, "This is not a genuine work of Rembrandt." The experts protested, "With these features of brush and paint, this painting cannot be any other artist's work!" The representative calmly explained, "This painting was created by an artificial intelligence system through __________. We are the engineers who developed that AI system."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 그림은 인공지능 시스템이 3D 프린팅을 통해 만들었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 3D printing ←정답
→ AI 시스템이 3D 프린팅으로 그림을 제작.

❌ ② oil painting (유화): AI 시스템과 무관.
❌ ③ hand drawing (수작업): AI와 모순.
❌ ④ digital photography (디지털 사진): 그림 제작이 아닌 촬영.
det.tip: 3D printing — AI가 렘브란트 스타일의 그림을 물리적으로 구현한 방법.

questions.passage: Now, we see AI platforms and apps that create pictures, music albums, and novels if we simply provide them with an idea. Although our question, "Can AI art be real art?", is still valid, AI can be a powerful source of __________ for artists. AI-generated art will continue to challenge our views on creativity in the arts and the human relationship with machine intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI는 예술가들에게 강력한 영감과 아이디어의 원천이 될 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① profit and fame (이익과 명성): 글의 핵심이 아님.
✅ ② inspiration and ideas (영감과 아이디어) ←정답
→ 예술가에게 영감과 아이디어를 주는 긍정적 맥락.
❌ ③ control and power (통제와 권력): 문맥 불일치.
❌ ④ criticism and doubt (비판과 의심): 긍정적 맥락에 반대.
det.tip: inspiration(영감) — source of inspiration = 영감의 원천.
